correctness.rationale: PASS: Every cycle of K_{2,n} is a four-cycle using two doubled columns, so an edge set is a forest iff at most one column contains both incident edges. The union of n n-balls B_i, each with common boundary Q_n=(S^0)^{*n}, yields S^n wedges and the exact equivariant relative homology sequence 0→H_n(X_n;Z)→Z^n⊗epsilon→Z⊗epsilon→0. Orientation of Q_n changes by (-1)^{n tau}sgn(sigma), so the full integral module is the sign-twisted augmentation kernel, not merely an equal-rank Q-module. Shapiro and the augmentation sequence give H^1(S_n,A_{n-1})=Z/n; the rational quotient has no positive invariants. Independent exact enumeration verified all face counts and Lefschetz characters of every 2n! automorphism for n=3,4,5,6 (1740 elements total). Uniform n proof, not finite extrapolation.
